title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Aker Systems was founded in 2017 by a team of experienced technology professionals who recognised an opportunity to provide highly secure enterprise data platforms to large organisations.  We build and operate ground-breaking, ultra-secure, high performance, cloud-based data infrastructure for the enterprise. Our proprietary technology solutions drive performance and reduce costs while helping our clients to improve the management and sharing of data across their organisations.

In 2024, Aker Systems won the Breakthrough Culture Awards highlighting growth companies putting culture first. In 2020 Aker Systems was recognised as a ‘One to Watch’ on the Sunday Times Tech Track.  The Company was also recognised at the Thames Valley Tech Awards 2020; winning the Thames Valley Tech Company of the year, the Emerging Tech Company and High Growth Tech Business categories.  We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.  We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, and supportive place for you to do your very best work.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Lead Data Engineer to design, build and evolve secure, scalable data platforms for clients across the UK Public Sector and Utilities sectors.

You will work closely with architects, engineers and client stakeholders to deliver modern cloud-based data solutions that support operational, analytical and AI-driven use cases. The role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering, helping clients modernise their data estates while ensuring solutions are secure, reliable and scalable.

Working across multiple projects, you will lead the development of batch and real-time data pipelines, support architectural decision-making, and help establish engineering best practices across delivery teams.

Strong experience with real-time streaming technologies is essential.

Key Responsibilities

description:
Chez MARGO, nos consultants travaillent sur ce qui compte vraiment : des projets complexes qui allient challenge intellectuel et impact business réel.
 C’est pourquoi nous accompagnons les plus grands acteurs de la finance, de l’industrie et de la tech sur leurs projets les plus stratégiques en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle.
 Vos missions
 Nous recherchons un Senior Data Engineer pour participer à la construction d’une plateforme Data développée from scratch, destinée à des équipes travaillant sur des problématiques de recherche et de calcul intensif.
 L’objectif de cette plateforme est de gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vie des données : ingestion, traitements distribués, backtesting à grande échelle et mise à disposition des données pour des usages de recherche et de production.
 L’un des enjeux techniques majeurs du projet concerne le calcul distribué et l’intégration de Spark au cœur de l’architecture de la plateforme.
 Dans ce contexte, vous interviendrez notamment sur :
 le développement des composants de calcul distribué,
 la conception et l’optimisation de pipelines de données à forte volumétrie,
 les problématiques de performance et de scalabilité liées aux traitements massifs,
 l’évolution de l’architecture Data,
 la qualité et la maintenabilité du code Python utilisé en production.
 Pourquoi rejoindre la practice ?
 Vous rejoindrez une practice en pleine construction, portée par une forte ambition technologique autour des infrastructures cloud, des plateformes data et des systèmes distribués.
 L’objectif n’est pas simplement d’accompagner des projets, mais de construire une communauté d’ingénieurs capables d’intervenir sur des sujets techniques exigeants : architecture cloud, calcul distribué, plateformes data, performance et scalabilité.
 Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où l’autonomie, la profondeur technique et la capacité à prendre des responsabilités sont valorisées dès le départ.

title: AI-First Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Join Sport Alliance and help build the data platform behind Magicline and Finion, serving thousands of gyms and 10M+ members. You'll tackle real engineering challenges, from high-volume data modeling and cost-efficient warehousing to freshness trade-offs and financial data that has to be exactly right.
 We're building an AI-first data team. We use cutting-edge LLMs and internal tools to work faster, and we expect you to use and improve them. The platform you build powers our AI and analytics, making clean, reliable, well-modeled data essential.
 Whether you're an experienced engineer ready to own the platform or a strong mid-level engineer eager to grow into the role, we'd love to hear from you.
 Your position in our team
 Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines on AWS — ETL/ELT and the infrastructure underneath (Aurora, Redshift, dbt, Spark/EMR, Airflow, CDC) — using AI tooling as a standard part of the workflow.
 Design and evolve the data models that power analytics, operational use cases, and AI/ML across thousands of studios.
 Help raise the bar on data reliability — embed governance, testing, and lineage so both people and AI systems can trust the numbers by default.
 Partner with product, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous business problems into robust data solutions.
 Evaluate and evolve new approaches with us — data mesh patterns, and emerging AI tooling — and help decide what genuinely earns a place in our stack.
 Grow into our financial and regulatory reporting workstream (Finion Capital), where correctness and auditability matter most.
 Your profile
 3+ years in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing — and the appetite to take on more ownership than you've held so far.
 Strong SQL and Python for data work.

title: Staff Analytics Engineer
description:

description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Anthropic's go-to-market teams are scaling quickly, and the decisions they make, from who to sell to and how to cover them to where to invest next, are only as good as the intelligence and infrastructure underneath them. As a Data Engineer on the GTM Systems data foundations team, you'll help build that layer: the data products that give sellers, operators, and analysts a rich, current, and trusted picture of the market, and the engineering rigor that lets our GTM systems run reliably as the business grows.

Alongside the build, you'll help shape what the data means: how attributes are defined, which sources are trusted, and how the business puts them to use. The role sits at the intersection of the sales organization, the data organization, and the systems that data flows through. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy and Operations, Finance, Data Science, and the central data engineering team.

 Bring disparate internal and external sources together: orchestrate, model, and normalize first-party product and revenue data alongside third-party data into one usable understanding of the company landscape

title: Security Data Engineer
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run.
 You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. The goal is security that runs itself: custody, access and evidence verified continuously from records, with tools and AI agents doing the reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.
 You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's compute and data center operations teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

title: Staff Data Engineer, Tech Foundations
description:

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 Staff Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations
 The Community You Will Join:
 At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.
 Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.
 You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.
 The Difference You Will Make:
 As a Staff Data Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.
